Thanks Marissa — good summary.

A few quick items from our side:
- Legal lead for NDA/MSA: Lisa Gomez (cc'd) — she will triage the NDA review.
- Procurement/P2P contact: Connor Reed <creed@novahealth.com> (I will intro you tomorrow).
- Economic buyer: Maya Singh (VP Product) — she is aligned on pilot goals and will be the approver for budget.

Timelines:
- NDA: legal can typically turn around a mutual NDA in ~7 business days if simple; if they want to redline heavily could be longer.
- MSA: expect 2\u20133 weeks depending on redlines; procurement/finance may add time for terms/pricing.
- PO: procurement usually requires an approved SOW + PO request; typical PO time 1\u20133 weeks after scope approval.

For the pilot we are flexible \u2014 I think sequencing NDA first makes sense. We would prefer to keep the DPA scoped to pilot later (post-signature) unless you need data processing terms earlier.

I'll make the procurement intro tomorrow and loop Maya for a quick pricing sync.

-Evan
